data.completion_memo: Implemented the framework-independent lossless workflow JSON parser/serializer/editor kernel with typed selection, immutable edits, undo/redo, and unknown-field preservation.
data.description: Implement framework-independent strict-TypeScript parsing, validation, serialization, selection, typed edit commands, transaction coalescing, undo/redo, schema-driven property drafts, and authority/dependency summaries for one workflow JSON document. Preserve unknown nodes, fields, connections, positions, groups, and comments without semantic loss.
data.title: M07.5 — Implement the lossless workflow editor kernel
